summary: Gu Suizhou experiences a milder-than-usual episode of his pheromone-related illness, which he suspects is linked to Shen Feizhi's presence. Xu Zhong, his associate, is relieved but concerned, rushing to procure more medication. Meanwhile, Leapton (Lai Gou) attempts to care for Shen Feizhi with a special meal, which Gu Suizhou ends up eating himself. Gu Suizhou observes the sleeping Shen Feizhi, noting his exceptional control over his pheromones and his high-level combat instincts, leading to a mix of suspicion and intrigue regarding Shen Feizhi's true background.
